storyboard.claim: The count, disguised as a priest, tracks Caderousse down.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Figure in black cassock in a rainy lane

image.subject: a shabby country inn at dusk in heavy rain, muddy yard, a sagging wooden sign, 1830s France

storyboard.claim: Caderousse runs a failing inn in the countryside.

image.subject: Caderousse, a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes stands by a bare wooden table in a dim tavern room beside a thin worn woman in a faded grey dress, Caderousse's wife, rain streaking the window

storyboard.claim: Caderousse and his wife are destitute when the count walks in.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two worn figures in a bare tavern room

image.subject: a tall pale man in a black abbé's cassock and wide-brimmed hat places a large sparkling diamond in the palm of Caderousse, a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes, across a scarred wooden table lit by one candle

storyboard.claim: The count hands Caderousse a diamond worth 50,000 francs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Diamond passed across a tavern table
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the scene on the gift

image.subject: close view of Caderousse, a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes's shifty eyes fixed on a diamond glinting in candlelight on a table

storyboard.claim: The gift is a deliberate test of Caderousse's morals.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Greedy eyes locked on a diamond

storyboard.claim: The count does not punish Caderousse; he drops a destabilizing fortune into the room.

image.subject: a neat Parisian jeweler in a grey frock coat with a leather case arrives at a rain-soaked inn doorway, lantern light on his coat

storyboard.claim: A Parisian jeweler arrives at the inn.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jeweler at inn door in rain

image.subject: a neat Parisian jeweler in a grey frock coat clamps a large diamond with steel pliers and sets it on a brass balance scale on a wooden table

storyboard.claim: The jeweler weighs the diamond with steel pliers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jeweler weighing a diamond on a table

image.subject: a stack of gold coins and folded banknotes on a wooden tavern table beside a diamond

storyboard.claim: After a tense bargain the jeweler pays about 45,000 francs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Gold coins and banknotes on the table

storyboard.claim: For a failing innkeeper in the 1830s, this is generational wealth.

image.subject: Danglars, a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face sits behind a polished desk in a Paris bank office with velvet-covered chairs, 1830s

storyboard.claim: We link financial corruption to bankers in velvet offices.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Banker at a desk in velvet office

image.subject: a crowded Paris bond exchange in the 1830s, men in dark coats gathered around a trading floor, ledgers and papers in hand

storyboard.claim: Greed is not only a sin of the rich.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from bankers to the poor

image.subject: a thin worn woman in a faded grey dress, Caderousse's wife leans over a wooden table, staring hungrily at a stack of gold coins by candlelight

storyboard.claim: Larant is consumed by the physical presence of the money.
The couple now holds a fortune that rescues them from starvation.
Money does not change your fundamental nature; it only accelerates it.

image.subject: a thin worn woman in a faded grey dress, Caderousse's wife grips a jeweler's sleeve across a tavern table, arguing, a pair of silver buckles lying between them

storyboard.claim: She haggles aggressively for an extra five francs of silver buckles.

image.subject: a dark tavern staircase at night, a single candle flickering at the top beside a closed bedroom door

storyboard.claim: Within hours the jeweler goes to sleep upstairs.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets the stage for the plot

image.subject: a dark wooden table with a diamond and a dark bottle, two shadowed figures leaning close beside a guttering candle

storyboard.claim: Haggling turns into a plot to murder the jeweler and take the diamond back.
The narrator admits a twinge of pity for Caderousse, who was not malicious at the start.

image.subject: Caderousse, a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes leans against a cracked doorframe of a crumbling inn, bowed back, grey dusk outside

storyboard.claim: Caderousse was weak and ground down by years of poverty.

image.subject: a thin sick woman lies under a thin blanket on a straw bed in a bare upper room, a candle on a crate, her husband seated beside her

storyboard.claim: His wife is dying of a chronic fever.
They are starving, and survival is on the line.

image.subject: a large diamond lying on a bare tavern table beside an empty bread board and a cracked jug, a candle burning low

storyboard.claim: A diamond on the table warps the mind; the poverty broke his morality first.
The socioeconomic argument does not excuse Caderousse.

image.subject: a row of poor cottages in a rain-soaked village at dawn, workers walking to the fields, smoke from low chimneys, 1830s France

storyboard.claim: Millions live in grinding poverty without turning to crime.

image.subject: an hourglass with sand running, set on a dark tavern table beside a diamond

storyboard.claim: The timeline shows Caderousse was not driven by immediate need.

left.label: PAID
left.subject: a leather purse of gold coins and banknotes on a tavern table

right.label: WANTS MORE
right.subject: a single diamond glinting on the same table

storyboard.claim: The jeweler had already paid, so the need was over.

image.subject: Caderousse, a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes seated at a table counting out banknotes by candlelight, a greedy look on his face

storyboard.claim: He killed for entitlement, not for survival.

image.subject: two hands, one holding a stack of banknotes and the other grasping a diamond, over a dark wooden table

storyboard.claim: He wanted both the money and the diamond.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two hands with notes and diamond

image.subject: a row of convicts in grey prison uniforms chained together on a stone quay at Toulon harbour, 1830s

storyboard.claim: His impatience gets him sent to the galleys.
Move from the inn to the apex of corporate greed in Paris.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from the inn to Paris

image.subject: a sheaf of government bond certificates on a polished bank desk beside a gilt inkwell, 1830s Paris

storyboard.claim: The narrative shifts to the bond market and a critique of capitalism.

image.subject: an opulent Paris banking office with gilt-framed mirrors, a huge mahogany desk and heavy velvet drapes, no one present, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The count's financial genius shows its teeth in a banking office.

image.subject: Danglars, a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face, now a baron, leans back in a velvet chair in his opulent office, the wealthiest banker in Paris

storyboard.claim: Danglars is now a baron and the most arrogant banker in Paris.

image.subject: The Count of Monte Cristo, a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, walks into a Paris banking office, a stout banker looking up from his desk with a condescending expression

storyboard.claim: The count walks in to open an account; Danglars patronizes him.

image.subject: a small velvet box lies open on a polished mahogany desk beside a gold pen, bearer bonds inside

storyboard.claim: The count opens a small velvet box and drops his bonds on the desk.
The count tells Danglars he expects unlimited credit on a million francs.

image.subject: Danglars, a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face wipes sweat from his forehead with a white handkerchief across a desk from a tall pale count

storyboard.claim: Danglars is sweating; he realizes he faces an apex predator.
To destroy a modern capitalist, the count does not use a knife; he uses market volatility.

image.subject: a leather-bound ledger open to rows of figures, a quill and inkwell beside it, candlelight

storyboard.claim: Audit the leverage, then trigger a margin call they cannot meet.
